name: message.received
description: A message someone sent to the owner (or to a chat the owner is in), observed in a source.

name: message.sent
description: A message the owner sent (from their own account), or the assistant's reply in an agent session.

name: message.edited
description: A previously observed message was edited in the source (new text in content).

name: message.deleted
description: A previously observed message was deleted in the source.

name: reaction.added
description: A reaction (emoji) to a message.

name: conversation.started
description: A conversation/session started (e.g. a Hermes session): platform, model, title.

name: conversation.ended
description: A conversation/session ended: reason, counts, tokens, cost.

name: tool.called
description: W.Alter called a tool. Metadata and references only, never the large output (A1).

name: skill.used
description: W.Alter used a procedural skill in a session.

name: note.recorded
description: An agent (Claude, Hermes) explicitly recorded a statement about the owner's life (what was said, by whom) — the statement itself, not an inference.

name: file.created
description: A raw file entered the Raw Vault (sent to W.Alter, imported, downloaded).

name: photo.taken
description: A photo/video captured by the owner's devices (EXIF time/place).

name: email.received
description: An e-mail received.

name: email.sent
description: An e-mail sent by the owner.

name: calendar.event
description: A calendar event (created/updated); content = title/description.

name: location.sample
description: A raw device location sample (local_only by default).

name: location.stay
description: A detected stay at a place (derived from samples by a deterministic L0 processor).

name: page.visited
description: A web page visited.

name: search.performed
description: A web search performed.

name: person.met
description: The owner met a person (calendar, location, explicit statement).

name: event.corrected
description: Correction of an earlier event (append-only history: the old event stays).

name: event.retracted
description: An earlier event is declared wrong/irrelevant (the old event stays; readers hide it).

name: document.section
description: One version of a section of a curated record the instance declares (decisions register, owner rules written down by an agent): its text at that version. A changed section is a new event; the previous one is retracted (walter_memory.documents).
